title: WeatherCore: Integrations
summary: Blend forecasts with maps, regions, farms, convoy routes, and survival warnings.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: WorldCore regions can combine with weather pressure, HoloMap helps choose alternates, TutorialCore can coach hazard mistakes, and Recovery can help after a bad forecast call.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Combine WeatherCore with WorldCore regions, HoloMap route alternatives, Recovery planning, and TutorialCore coaching after weather-related mistakes.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: Without linked forecasts, watch the sky, carry shelter supplies, and plan shorter routes when exposure would be expensive.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
